subject: Fix pointer-to-int-cast warnings for RDMA address handling (#3186)
reason: The change only inserts intermediate (uintptr_t) casts when converting between pointers and uint64_t in src/rdma.c and tests/rdma/rdma-test.c to fix compiler pointer-to-int-cast warnings. On the supported 64-bit platforms the resulting values are bit-identical to the parent build, so there is no behaviour change to observe: no reply, replication, persistence or crash path differs. Moreover the touched code is the RDMA transport, which requires RDMA NICs/rdma_cm and cannot be reached by the fuzzer's local TCP deployments. A build-warning refactor with no behaviour change gets no scenario.
